title: Single-Flight OAuth Token Refresh
signature: class AuthClient: __init__(loop, token, refresh, send), call(request) -> generator returning the response dict
hints: Remember which token you sent with. A 401 only proves that token is bad, not the one you hold now.
Keep one slot for the refresh Task in flight. The first 401 spawns it with loop.spawn; every other 401 just does `yield task`.
Clear the slot in a finally block inside the refresh task, so a failed refresh does not poison every later call.
After the refresh (or after noticing the token already changed), send once more with self.token and return whatever comes back.
